annotations.title: List paywalls, onboarding flows and placements

description: Every paywall and onboarding flow, what is actually being served at each placement (running experiment > live > none), and the valid placement names. IMPORTANT: read `placements` before writing a placement string into code. The list is configured ∪ observed, so a name that appears only under `observed` is usually a typo in the app — and a placement that does not exist renders nothing at all, with no error.
